verses.text: This is my third visit to you. Scripture says, ‘Every matter must be confirmed by the testimony of two or three witnesses.’
I warned you when I was there the second time, and I'm warning you again now while I'm away: if I come again, I won't spare those who sinned before or anyone else.
You want proof that Christ speaks through me. He isn't weak toward you; he shows his power among you.
He was crucified in weakness, but he lives by God's power. We too are weak in him, but we'll live with him by God's power among you.
Examine yourselves to see whether you're living in the faith. Test yourselves. Don't you realize that Jesus Christ is in you?—unless you fail the test.
I hope you'll recognize that we haven't failed the test.
I pray to God that you won't do anything wrong—not so we can look successful, but so you'll do what is right, even if we seem to have failed.
We can't do anything against the truth; we can only work for the truth.
We're glad when we're weak and you're strong. We also pray that you'll be fully restored.
That's why I'm writing this while I'm away: so I won't have to be harsh when I come, using the authority the Lord gave me to build you up, not tear you down.
Finally, brothers and sisters: celebrate, be restored, encourage one another, agree with one another, and live in peace. Then the God of love and peace will be with you.
Greet one another with a holy kiss.
All God's people here send you their greetings.
May the grace of the Lord Jesus Christ, the love of God, and the fellowship of the Holy Spirit be with you all. Amen.
